description: Phase B: Admin Federation in moovv-fit-docs. Update the backend SDK API (moovv-fit-backend-node) multi-pool verifier to support Docs Pool tokens AND Pool B tokens with moovv_admin group for admin access. The Docs frontend calls the SDK API which validates tokens - there is no separate Docs API authorizer. The change is in the backend's JWT verification to accept Pool B admin tokens when accessing Docs-related endpoints.
steps: 1. Add Docs Pool configuration to /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/shared/auth/multiPoolVerifier.ts: Add COGNITO_DOCS_POOL_ID env var support (default: 'ap-south-1_fYA6SWSpX'). Create third verifier instance for Docs Pool. Update extractPoolFromIss() to detect 'DOCS' pool. Update verify() to try Docs Pool as well.
2. Extend MultiPoolTokenPayload type in multiPoolVerifier.ts to include pool: 'A' | 'B' | 'DOCS'.

3. Create /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/shared/middleware/docsAuth.ts middleware: (a) Validates token using multi-pool verification. (b) For Docs Pool tokens: grants partner developer access (existing flow). (c) For Pool B tokens: checks if 'moovv_admin' is in cognito:groups claim - if yes, grants admin access; if no, denies. (d) Returns DocsAccessClaims with accessLevel ('partner' | 'admin'), sub, and partnerId (for partner access).

4. Update existing Docs-related handlers (or create them if they don't exist) to use verifyDocsToken() middleware. The SDK API already handles partner auth via invite codes - this adds Pool B admin federation.
5. Add environment variables to /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/serverless.yml: COGNITO_DOCS_POOL_ID, COGNITO_DOCS_CLIENT_ID with defaults for ap-south-1_fYA6SWSpX region.

6. Create /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/src/shared/auth/docsPoolVerifier.ts as a focused verifier for Docs Pool + Pool B admin federation, to keep multi-pool verifier focused on Pool A/B for the main app.
7. Update /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-backend-node/.env.example to include COGNITO_DOCS_POOL_ID and COGNITO_DOCS_CLIENT_IDS with comments explaining Pool B admin federation.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without errors in moovv-fit-backend-node
DocsPoolVerifier can validate both Docs Pool tokens and Pool B tokens
Pool B tokens are only accepted for admin access when moovv_admin group is present
Docs Pool tokens continue to work for partner developer access (backward compatible)
No changes required in moovv-fit-docs CDK stack - auth federation happens at SDK API level
findings: DocsPoolVerifier created as a separate verifier (not extending MultiPoolVerifier) to keep concerns separated. The verifier supports: (1) Docs Pool tokens granting 'partner' access with optional partnerId from custom:partnerId claim, (2) Pool B tokens with moovv_admin group granting 'admin' access. Environment variables added: COGNITO_DOCS_POOL_ID (default: ap-south-1_fYA6SWSpX), COGNITO_DOCS_CLIENT_IDS, COGNITO_POOL_B_ID, COGNITO_POOL_B_CLIENT_IDS. Mock tokens available for local dev: mock-docs-admin-token and mock-docs-partner-token.
